items.title: Christian McBride interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: You know people like Jimmy Smith and Horace Silver, Les McCann.

ctx.x: It’s interesting, just to wrap this up, but it seems sometimes your listening tastes and I’m talking generally, sometimes to work backwards, like you know you start out with a certain thing and then you find out where that went — where’d that come from? And where’d that come from?

Well that’s like I said, evolution. You know that’s what happens, the natural evolution of your ideas happens from things that happen before then and before then and before that and before that. You know. So we’ll see what happens in the future. The biggest thing I’m planning for right now is I’m actually already planning my third album. As you know and as I’ve said earlier, James Brown has always been my childhood hero, and it would be the dream of a lifetime to record with James Brown. But I would think how,…
